# Addresszen

AddressZen provides address autocomplete and verification services, offering real-time address suggestions and validation to ensure accurate and deliverable addresses.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/addresszen/.

## Actions

- **Key Availability** (read-only): Get public information on an api key, including whether it is currently usable.
- **Resolve Address USA** (read-only): Resolve an address autocompletion by its address id and return the full address in us format.
